                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES

## Scope and Interpretation

## 1.1

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 1.1] This Practice Direction prescribes the procedure for the
                                                transfer of work from a county court prior to its closure.

## 1.2

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 1.2] In this Practice Direction –

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 1.2] ‘closing court’ means a court
                                                                which is subject to closure; and

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 1.2] ‘recipient court’ means a
                                                                court or courts to which work from the closing court is to be transferred in
                                                                accordance with paragraphs 2.1 – 2.5.

## Transfer of Work

## 2.1

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 2.1] If a court is to be closed, work shall be transferred to
                                                the recipient court which has been identified in directions made by the Lord
                                                Chancellor, under section 2 of the County Courts Act 1984, having consulted the
                                                Lord Chief Justice and, where necessary, following consultation between the
                                                Lord Chief Justice and the Master of the Rolls, Chancellor of the High Court or
                                                the President of the Family Division.

## 2.2

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 2.2] The transfer of work shall, so far as possible and
                                                subject to any direction of a judge in any particular case, be in accordance
                                                with the annexed schedules, namely: ‘Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings
                                                (generally)’, ‘Schedule 2 – Family Proceedings’ and ‘Schedule 3 –
                                                Insolvency Proceedings’ (‘the schedules’).

## 2.3

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 2.3] Any case falling outside the categories of work listed in
                                                the schedules will be referred to a judge in the closing court for
                                                determination of the appropriate recipient court.

## 2.4

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 2.4] If a case is transferred from the closing court to a
                                                recipient court by an order made under rule 3.3(4) of the Civil Procedure Rules
                                                or rule 4.3(4) of the Family Procedure Rules, the closing court shall notify
                                                all parties that they may apply to the recipient court, on notice and within 7
                                                days of the date of service of the transfer order, to vary the court to which
                                                the case should be transferred.

## 2.5

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > 2.5] On the date that a court closes, all work which has not
                                                previously been transferred from that court shall be transferred to the
                                                recipient court or courts in accordance with paragraph 2.1.

## ANNEX

## Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] Key | Court

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] Court A | Closing Court

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] Court B | Recipient Court. There may be more than one
                                                                         recipient court.

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] Number | Timing (period prior to closure) | Procedure | Action (subject to any direction of a judge in
                                                                         accordance with paragraph 2.2 of the Practice Direction)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 1.1 | 3 months | Request to issue a Part 7 claim at Court A | Transfer to and issue in the name of Court B

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 1.2 | 3 months | Cases transferred to Court A on receipt of a
                                                                         defence from a defendant | Case to remain at Court A for directions under
                                                                         CPR Part 26

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 1.3 | 3 months | Requirement to list a case/application for date
                                                                         post-closure | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 2 | 2 months | Request to issue Part 8 claim at Court A
                                                                         (including claim for possession under Part 55) | Issue the case at Court A but transfer
                                                                         proceedings to Court B for that court to list for hearing

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 3.1 | 6 weeks | Request to issue or re-issue warrant of execution
                                                                         (including possession warrants not issued through PCOL) where Court A is the
                                                                         home court | Transfer warrant to Court B for execution

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 3.2 | 6 weeks | Receipt of a foreign warrant (electronic) | Before printing – update executing field to
                                                                         ‘Court B’ (where it will then be executed as a foreign warrant)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 3.3 | 6 weeks | Receipt of foreign warrant (paper) | Forward to Court B for manual input and
                                                                         execution

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 3.4 | 6 weeks | Receipt of possession warrants from PCOL | Update executing field to ‘Court B’. This
                                                                         will create a final return – warrants should then be entered as a foreign
                                                                         warrant at Court B

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 4 | 2 months (or when lists become full, whichever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Receipt of enforcement process that requires a
                                                                         hearing, including applications for an order to obtain information from
                                                                         judgment debtors | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 1 – Civil Proceedings (generally)] 5 | 2 months | Consolidated orders | Transfer to Court B following payment of
                                                                         dividend

[PRACTICE

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 2 – Family Proceedings] Number | Timing (months prior to closure) | Procedure | Action (subject to any direction of a judge in
                                                                         accordance with paragraph 2.2 of the Practice Direction)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 2 – Family Proceedings] 1.1 | 3 months | Request to issue new family proceedings | To be forwarded to and issued in the name of
                                                                         Court B

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 2 – Family Proceedings] 1.2 | 3 months | Request to issue applications within existing
                                                                         family proceedings | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing

## Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] Key | Court

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] Court A | Closing Court

                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] Number | Timing (months prior to closure) | Procedure | Action (subject to any direction of a judge in
                                                                         accordance with paragraph 2.2 of the Practice Direction)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] 1.1 | 2 months (or when lists become full which ever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Insolvency – creditors petitions | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] 1.2 | 2 months (or when lists become full, whichever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Insolvency – winding up petitions (High
                                                                         Court) | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] 1.3 | 2 months (or when lists become full which ever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Insolvency – statutory demands | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing (should judicial practice be to list for hearing)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] 1.4 | 2 months (or when lists become full which ever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Insolvency – company voluntary
                                                                         arrangements | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing (should judicial practice be to list for hearing)

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] 1.5 | 2 months (or when lists become full which ever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Insolvency – transfers in from other county
                                                                         courts | Transfer to Court B

[PRACTICE
                         DIRECTION – COUNTY COURT CLOSURES > Schedule 3 – Insolvency Proceedings] 1.6 | 2 months (or when lists become full which ever is
                                                                         the sooner) | Insolvency – applications | Transfer proceedings to Court B for that court to
                                                                         list for hearing (should a hearing be necessary)
